posts.text: my aries mars does not 'miss the exit'. i take the feeder, catch the light, u-turn under the overpass and rejoin the katy freeway forty seconds ahead of you, which is the only number i care about
posts.caption: The feeder road was built for people like us

posts.text: your honor, my aries client did not 'cut across four lanes of 610'. she saw the galleria exit at the last possible second and made a leadership decision. the other drivers are simply not leaders
posts.caption: The West Loop rewards commitment

posts.text: i got an ez tag for the same reason i do everything as an aries: so i never have to slow down. not for the toll plaza on beltway 8, not for traffic, and definitely not for my own feelings
posts.caption: Toll paid. Emotions skipped.

posts.text: i was told mutton bustin at the rodeo is for children under a certain weight. as an aries i heard the word 'competition' and stopped listening. security at nrg has asked me to sit down twice
posts.caption: Cardinal fire versus one very confused sheep

posts.text: every hurricane season my aries sun buys zero supplies until the first cone of uncertainty, then i'm at h-e-b at 6am treating the water aisle like game seven. i do not need forty cases. i need to win
posts.caption: Hurricane prep, but make it a contact sport

posts.text: an aries will leave an astros game at daikin park in the seventh inning to beat traffic on 59, hear the comeback on the radio, and genuinely feel like they won both
posts.caption: First out of the garage is still first

posts.text: my taurus love language is pulling off i-10 at the katy buc-ee's, buying you a brisket sandwich and saying nothing. if i hand you the beaver nuggets first, we are basically engaged
posts.caption: Venus-ruled and fluent in gas station brisket

posts.text: your honor, my taurus client did not 'refuse to leave the line at the breakfast klub'. she had already waited forty minutes for chicken and waffles and now considers that spot her legal residence
posts.caption: Fixed earth does not abandon a queue

posts.text: a taurus in houston has two seasons: crawfish season and waiting for crawfish season. please do not invite my taurus moon anywhere in july unless there is a viet-cajun boil on bellaire involved
posts.caption: Weather is irrelevant. Mudbugs are the calendar.

posts.text: minutes from the katy hoa meeting: the taurus in cinco ranch has been asked for the fourth time to repaint her shutters. she has replied for the fourth time that she likes them. item closed
posts.caption: The HOA met a fixed sign and lost

posts.text: my taurus sun has ordered the same number one at the same whataburger off the north freeway since 2009. they announced new menu items. i was informed. i was not moved
posts.caption: Loyalty, with grilled onions

posts.text: my taurus placements walked into gallery furniture 'just to look' and left four hours later with a recliner, a mattress and a deep respect for mattress mack. for a taurus, comfort is not a purchase. it's a value system
posts.caption: He did, in fact, save me money

posts.text: a gemini will tell you everything in houston is twenty minutes away. the heights, twenty minutes. sugar land, twenty minutes. galveston, twenty minutes. my gemini mercury is not lying. it simply believes in me
posts.caption: H-Town distance is measured in optimism

posts.text: my gemini sun has a 713 number for the friends i met in montrose and a 281 number for the friends i met in katy, and those two group chats have never once been in the same room
posts.caption: Two area codes, one very busy twin

posts.text: as a gemini i change lanes on 59 the way i change opinions: constantly, confidently, and with a turn signal that is technically on but has not been relevant since bellaire
posts.caption: Mutable air, mutable lane

posts.text: i went to the rothko chapel to sit in silence with my thoughts, which as a gemini meant sitting in silence with eleven thoughts all talking at once, two of them about tacos after
posts.caption: The chapel was quiet. The gemini was not.

posts.text: at the rodeo my gemini rising did the cook-off, the carnival, the pig races and the concert. when someone asked which one i actually came for, i said yes, obviously, all of them, in that order and also reversed
posts.caption: RodeoHouston, but every tab open at once

posts.text: dating a gemini is skating laps at the galleria ice rink while they narrate the love lives of every couple under the giant tree. they have never met any of them. they have detailed theories about all of them
posts.caption: Mercury-ruled and very invested in strangers

posts.text: every june my cancer moon updates her hurricane kit: water, batteries, flashlight, our old texts, the hoodie you left in my car and a photo of us at the hermann park reflection pool, in case of emotional landfall
posts.caption: Prepared for every storm except you

posts.text: a cancer will move across the country and still keep the 713 number, purely so my mom's phone shows the same contact photo it has since 2008. that is not a phone plan. that is an heirloom
posts.caption: Moon-ruled and permanently area code 713

posts.text: my cancer sun cannot drive past a shipley do-nuts without remembering every saturday my dad bought a dozen glazed and let me hold the box in the back seat. i'm not crying. it's the humidity
posts.caption: Glazed, warm and deeply sentimental

posts.text: as a crab, my cancer sun feels a complicated kinship at every viet-cajun crawfish boil. i still eat four pounds. i just make eye contact with the tray and say 'nothing personal' first
posts.caption: Crustacean solidarity has its limits

posts.text: my cancer moon still waves at the astrodome every time i drive past it on 610. it's not doing anything. neither am i. we are just two old souls holding onto the good years
posts.caption: The Eighth Wonder and its most loyal fan

posts.text: inviting a cancer to a party outside the loop is a two-step process. first you invite her. then you wait three business days while she decides if her feelings can survive beltway 8 after dark
posts.caption: The shell does not travel past the Beltway lightly

posts.text: my leo sun did not get candy paint and swangas because i 'wanted attention'. the houston sun is out most of the year and frankly it deserves something to look at
posts.caption: Slab culture, but make it sun-ruled

posts.text: i entered the art car parade on allen parkway and as a leo i'd like to clarify that it is no longer a car. it is a float with my face on both doors and a speaker that only plays applause
posts.caption: Main character, now street legal

posts.text: a leo does not 'go to the galleria'. a leo arrives at the galleria, does one slow lap of the ice rink so the second floor can see, buys nothing and leaves completely fulfilled
posts.caption: The rink is a runway if you believe

posts.text: go texan day is the one day a year my leo rising can wear rhinestone boots, fringe and a hat the size of a satellite dish to a quarterly budget meeting, and hr has to call it heritage
posts.caption: Western wear, Leo volume

posts.text: my leo venus has one dating rule: if we go to a rockets game at toyota center and the kiss cam finds us, you commit. you do not wave it off. you do not laugh. you give the people a show
posts.caption: The Jumbotron is a sacred contract

posts.text: as a leo i fully understand mattress mack. if i owned a furniture store i would also stand in front of the camera and promise to save you money with my whole chest. that's not marketing. that's a leo sun with a warehouse
posts.caption: Respect to the most Leo energy in H-Town

posts.text: my virgo moon will eat the sausage kolache from shipley, enjoy it, then gently explain to the whole office that technically it's a klobasnik. nobody asked. next time i'm bringing a pamphlet
posts.caption: Correct, unprompted and holding a glazed

posts.text: a virgo will sit down for tex-mex, order the fajitas, and walk the table through the history of ninfa's on navigation before the queso arrives. we are not fun at dinner. we are, however, correct
posts.caption: Tex-Mex, served with footnotes and a citation

posts.text: my virgo sun has tracked the i-45 construction in a color-coded spreadsheet for years. i have no authority. no one asked. but somebody has to know which lanes are closed tonight and it might as well be me
posts.caption: TxDOT has a project manager. So do I.

posts.text: the hurricane kit of a houston virgo: labeled water, sorted batteries, a laminated evacuation route and a spare kit for the friend who has been 'meaning to get to it' for six seasons. that friend is a sagittarius
posts.caption: Prepared for the storm and for you

posts.text: a virgo runs the memorial park loop at 6am, logs the exact three miles, then drafts a polite note to the conservancy about a mile marker that feels four feet off. we love the park. we love accuracy more
posts.caption: Personal best, professional concerns

posts.text: my virgo rising spent ninety minutes on my hair, walked from the car to a patio in midtown and arrived looking gently microwaved. houston humidity is the only thing that has ever corrected a virgo
posts.caption: Ninety minutes of work, undone in one block

posts.text: mercury retrograde in houston just means the feeder is closed, the u-turn is closed, the detour is closed, and the gps lady has started sounding like she personally needs a hug
posts.caption: Retrograde, or just Tuesday in H-Town

posts.text: every houston birth chart has the same hidden placement: the urge to wear a puffer jacket to h-e-b the second it drops below 65 degrees. we have never needed the puffer. we know this. we wear it anyway
posts.caption: Two seasons, one emotionally necessary jacket

posts.text: you can read a houstonian's whole birth chart from their answer to 'how far is the galleria'. 'fifteen minutes' is fire. 'depends on 610' is earth. a long sigh is water. 'i've never been' is a lie
posts.caption: Element assigned by commute

posts.text: the astrologer said my venus is in a tense aspect this month and honestly so is everyone on the katy freeway at 5:15. we are all just trying to merge with someone who has made it clear they are not letting us in
posts.caption: Venus and I-10 are both difficult right now
